localizedValues.name: C1
localizedValues.description: This ADA accessible cabin is near the full-utility campsites and has great views of the Columbia River and Rocky Reach Dam. This cabin is 26-feet long, has two rooms, and an 8-foot covered porch. This cabin is furnished with a queen-size futon, a bunk bed that sleeps three, small end table, heater, and air conditioner. Outside is a picnic table and fire pit with grate. Restrooms and showers are nearby.

localizedValues.name: C5
localizedValues.description: This deluxe cabin is 16-by-25 feet in size and equipped with a bunk bed that sleeps four, a queen size futon, three small end tables, a six-person dining table with chairs, a kitchenette with mini-refrigerator, microwave and sink, counter space with cupboards, and a bathroom with shower. This cabin also has on-demand hot water, a ceiling fan with lights, heat, and air-conditioning.  Outside of the cabin is a fire pit, picnic table, BBQ brazier, a 6-foot covered porch, and a buffer of irrigated, maintained grass turf.
